_note: Fixed picture style of the channel. Identical in every video; change only when the user asks.
style_block: STYLE: clean 2D vector explainer illustration exactly like the STYLE reference: thin clean uniform black outlines, flat solid colors with soft simple shading, plain white background, lots of empty space, simple readable educational composition; diagrams and cross-sections use plain straight arrows. All people are stick figures: thin single-line body, arms and legs, round plain white head, small solid black dot eyes (no eye whites, no pupils, no eyelids); emotion is shown only with eyebrow lines, the mouth and body pose. Other people (tribes, Neanderthals, strangers) are drawn in the same stick-figure style; only the hero has his unique look from the HERO reference. Animals and dinosaurs are drawn simply in the same clean line style. Rich, clear natural colours (green grass and leaves, brown fur, grey rock, blue sky and water); orange and red as accents for fire and danger.

shot_types.hero_location: the hero inside the environment, wide or medium shot, eye level, environment drawn simply
shot_types.object: a single object, small group of objects or simple diagram isolated on a plain white background, no character
shot_types.big_text: large bold text as the main element on a plain white background with one small supporting illustration
shot_types.closeup: close-up of the hero's face, upper body or hands, plain light background

location_prompt: Location design in exactly the same drawing style as the STYLE reference image, no characters: {description}. Wide shot, everything drawn simply, lots of empty space. 16:9 frame, no text, no watermark.
quality_rule: Colours are clear, clean and full, like in the STYLE reference. The picture is never faded, washed-out, greyish, hazy, dusty, low-contrast or desaturated, whatever the time of day. But it is not too bright either: no neon, oversaturated or glowing colours, no overexposed light.
character_prompt: Character design sheet in exactly the same drawing style as the STYLE reference: {description}. One single full-body view, side-on or three-quarter, neutral pose, plain white background, nothing else in the frame. 16:9 frame, no text, no watermark.
